privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how [Company Legal Name] ("Zyft", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use the Zyft app. By using Zyft, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
body: We collect information you provide directly, information generated by your use of the app, and limited technical information about your device.
bullets: Account information: name, email address, username/handle, and profile photo.
Content you post: workout logs, photos, captions, comments, and reactions.
Social information: who you follow, who follows you, and your interactions with other users' posts.
Usage data: pages viewed, features used, and general app activity.
Device information: device type, operating system, and app version, used for troubleshooting and compatibility.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
body: We use the information we collect to:
bullets: Operate and maintain your account and the core features of Zyft.
Display your workouts, posts, and profile to other users according to your privacy settings.
Personalize your feed, recommendations, and notifications.
Communicate with you about your account, updates, or support requests.
Monitor, secure, and improve the app, and investigate abuse or violations of our Terms of Service.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing of Information
body: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only in the following circumstances:
bullets: With other users, according to your account's privacy setting (public or private) — for example, your posts, profile, and activity are visible to your followers or the public feed.
With service providers who help us operate Zyft, such as cloud hosting and image storage providers (e.g. Cloudinary), under contractual obligations to protect your data.
If required by law, legal process, or to protect the rights, safety, or property of Zyft, our users, or the public.
In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, with notice to you where required.

sections.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
body: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Your account preferences, such as your selected language and display theme, are stored locally on your device using browser local storage, in addition to data stored on our servers.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights and Choices
body: Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including the right to:
bullets: Access, correct, or update your account information at any time through your profile settings.
Delete your account, which removes your profile and posts from Zyft, subject to our data retention obligations.
Control who can see your content through your account's privacy setting.
Opt out of non-essential communications from us.
sections.footer: To exercise these rights, contact us using the information in the "Contact Us" section below.

sections.heading: 6. Children's Privacy
body: Zyft is not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the minimum age required by your country), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under that age. If we learn we have collected such information, we will delete it.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and Local Storage
body: We use local storage (not third-party tracking cookies) to remember your login session, language preference, and display theme. You can clear this data through your browser or device settings, though doing so may log you out or reset your preferences.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the app or by other means before the changes take effect. Continued use of Zyft after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Us
body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact us at [contact@zyft-app-placeholder.com].

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of Zyft (the "App"), operated by [Company Legal Name] ("we", "us", or "our"). By creating an account or using Zyft, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: 1. Eligibility
body: You must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum age of digital consent in your country) to use Zyft. By using the app, you represent that you meet this requirement. If you are under 18, you confirm you have permission from a parent or guardian to use Zyft.

sections.heading: 2. Your Account
body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use of your account.
You agree to provide accurate information when creating your account and to keep it up to date.

sections.heading: 3. User Content
body: You retain ownership of the workouts, photos, comments, and other content you post to Zyft ("User Content"). By posting User Content, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, display, and distribute that content within the app as necessary to operate the service.
You are solely responsible for your User Content and confirm you have the rights necessary to post it.

sections.heading: 4. Community Guidelines
body: When using Zyft, you agree not to:
bullets: Post content that is harassing, hateful, sexually explicit, or that promotes violence or self-harm.
Impersonate another person or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or entity.
Post false or misleading fitness, health, or medical information.
Use the app to spam, scrape data, or interfere with its normal operation.
Violate any applicable law or the rights of others.
sections.footer: We reserve the right to remove content or suspend accounts that violate these guidelines.

sections.heading: 5. Health and Fitness Disclaimer
body: Zyft is a fitness tracking and social platform, not a medical service. Content on Zyft, including workouts, tips, and posts from other users, is not medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning any exercise program, especially if you have a pre-existing health condition.
You use Zyft's fitness tracking and workout features at your own risk. We are not responsible for injuries or health issues resulting from activities logged or discovered through the app.

sections.heading: 6. Third-Party Services
body: Zyft may rely on third-party services (such as image hosting providers) to operate certain features. We are not responsible for the practices or content of third-party services, and your use of them may be subject to separate terms.

sections.heading: 7. Termination
body: You may delete your account at any time through your account settings. We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, engage in fraudulent or harmful activity, or for other reasons at our discretion, with notice where reasonably practicable.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
body: Zyft is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee the app will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, [Company Legal Name] shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.

sections.heading: 9. Governing Law
body: These Terms are governed by the laws of [Jurisdiction], without regard to its conflict of law principles. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts located in [Jurisdiction].

sections.heading: 10. Changes to These Terms
body: We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the app before the changes take effect. Continued use of Zyft after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
body: If you have questions about these Terms, contact us at [contact@zyft-app-placeholder.com].
